description: This file declares helper functions and templates for sending and receiving file descriptors over Unix domain sockets, wrapping the complex cmsg(3) API to make it easier and less error-prone.

methods.name: SendFileDescriptorVector
methods.description: Sends file descriptors and data over a Unix domain socket.

methods.name: ReceiveFileDescriptorVector
methods.description: Receives file descriptors and data from a Unix domain socket.

methods.name: ssize_t SendFileDescriptors(borrowed_fd sock,const void * data,size_t len,Args &&...sent_fds)
methods.description: Helper template that constructs a vector of file descriptors and sends them along with data.

methods.name: ssize_t ReceiveFileDescriptors(borrowed_fd sock,void * data,size_t len,Args &&...received_fds)
methods.description: Helper template that receives a specified number of file descriptors and data.

ctags.name: ReceiveFileDescriptors
ctags.pattern: /^ssize_t ReceiveFileDescriptors(borrowed_fd sock, void* data, size_t len, Args&&... received_fds)/

ctags.name: SendFileDescriptors
ctags.pattern: /^ssize_t SendFileDescriptors(borrowed_fd sock, const void* data, size_t len, Args&&... sent_fds) /
